description: This file contains utility functions and setup procedures for testing Keystone.js applications with Prisma, including environment setup, database configuration, and Prisma client initialization.

methods.name: getTestPrismaModuleInner
methods.description: Creates a Prisma client module with schema and data model based on provided schema and path.

methods.name: getTestPrismaModule
methods.description: Caches and retrieves a Prisma client module for a given schema.

methods.name: setupTestEnv
methods.description: Sets up a testing environment with database configuration, system creation, and Prisma client initialization.

methods.name: setupTestSuite
methods.description: Prepares and tears down a test suite for Keystone.js applications with Prisma.
